functions.name: can_access_accounting
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_accounting()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles p
      where p.id = auth.uid()
        and p.role = 'owner'
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.accounting_users au
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = au.profile_id
      where au.profile_id = auth.uid()
        and au.active = true
        and coalesce(p.role, 'accounting') = 'accounting'
    ),
    false
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_role()
 RETURNS app_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()
$function$

functions.name: has_staff_permission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_staff_permission(required_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.staff s
      join public.staff_permissions sp on sp.staff_id = s.id
      where s.profile_id = auth.uid()
        and s.active = true
        and sp.permission_key = required_key
        and sp.enabled = true
    ),
    false
  )
$function$

functions.name: is_accounting_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_accounting_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles p
      where p.id = auth.uid()
        and p.role = 'owner'
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.accounting_users au
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = au.profile_id
      where au.profile_id = auth.uid()
        and au.active = true
        and au.access_level in ('owner', 'admin')
        and coalesce(p.role, 'accounting') = 'accounting'
    ),
    false
  )
$function$

functions.name: is_operations_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_operations_user()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(public.current_user_role() in ('owner', 'admin', 'front_desk'), false)
$function$

functions.name: is_owner_or_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_owner_or_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(public.current_user_role() in ('owner', 'admin'), false)
$function$

relations.name: accounting_entries
relations.view:
SELECT se.id,
    se.entered_at,
    se.entry_type,
    se.artist_id,
    st.display_name AS artist_name,
    se.customer_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    se.project_id,
    p.subject AS project_subject,
    se.tattoo_amount,
    se.tattoo_payment_method,
    se.tip_amount,
    se.tip_payment_method,
    se.merch_amount,
    se.merch_payment_method,
    se.tattoo_amount + se.tip_amount + se.merch_amount AS total_amount,
    se.memo,
    0::numeric(10,2) AS deposit_amount,
    NULL::payment_method AS deposit_payment_method
   FROM session_entries se
     LEFT JOIN staff st ON st.id = se.artist_id
     LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = se.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = se.project_id
UNION ALL
 SELECT d.id,
    COALESCE(d.used_at, d.received_at) AS entered_at,
    'deposit'::entry_type AS entry_type,
    NULL::uuid AS artist_id,
    NULL::text AS artist_name,
    d.customer_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    d.project_id,
    p.subject AS project_subject,
    0::numeric(10,2) AS tattoo_amount,
    NULL::payment_method AS tattoo_payment_method,
    0::numeric(10,2) AS tip_amount,
    NULL::payment_method AS tip_payment_method,
    0::numeric(10,2) AS merch_amount,
    NULL::payment_method AS merch_payment_method,
    d.amount AS total_amount,
    COALESCE(d.memo, 'Forfeited deposit'::text) AS memo,
    d.amount AS deposit_amount,
    d.payment_method AS deposit_payment_method
   FROM deposits d
     LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = d.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = d.project_id
  WHERE d.disposition = 'forfeited'::text;
